original_test_intent: Measure `device_to_device_bidirectional_memcpy_read_sm` total bandwidth for every ordered GPU pair and determine whether pair results meet the platform-approved similarity rule for their topology class.
original_method: Pin nvbandwidth source/binary/hash and review installer; use approved isolated build/dependencies; map output row/column ordinals to GPU UUID/BDF and NVLink/PCIe topology/peer access; preserve baseline; run tracked full matrix with telemetry/timeout; retain raw per-pair GB/s and errors; group by expected path class and calculate approved variance/floor; verify links/logs and cleanup.
manual_activity: Fabric owner pins tool/topology and defines similarity/reference; operator approves installer and multi-GPU traffic; agent may build/run and calculate the matrix after gates pass.
required_inputs: Pinned nvbandwidth revision/binary/hash and reviewed debian_install.sh
Approved dependencies, CUDA/driver/compiler and out-of-tree build plan
GPU UUID/BDF to row/column map, NVLink/PCIe topology and peer-access state
Numeric similarity/floor/variance/asymmetry policy by path class and reference
SUT isolation, package-change approval, telemetry/timeout and recovery
safety_requirements: Never execute a moving repository installer without review
Do not compare unlike topology classes as though equal
Track process/children and preserve raw matrix
Abort on XID, link error/degradation, thermal/power or management anomaly
Do not reset GPUs or leave unapproved package changes
agent_execution_scope: Build in approved location and run full matrix
Calculate every pair/path-class comparison with telemetry/errors
engineer_actions: Define topology-aware similarity and approve installer/reference

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic nvbandwidth language omits the named matrix, row/column identity and pairwise similarity criterion.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run pinned approved nvbandwidth, capture the complete named matrix, map every cell to physical GPU pair/path class and calculate the authorized GB/s floor/variance/asymmetry rules.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The named test and full all-GPU matrix plus 60-minute estimates are preserved; `similar` is not invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a labeled GPU-by-GPU matrix with topology class, direction, GB/s, class median, deviation and threshold result while retaining raw output.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns a subjective visual comparison into a traceable topology-aware calculation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An aggregate or NCCL bandwidth score cannot reveal one weak/asymmetric GPU pair.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Direct/NVLink and indirect/PCIe paths need not share one performance band; an all-cells-equal oracle would be technically invalid.

project_override_considerations: Fabric owner defines comparable path groups, handling of diagonals/unreachable pairs, absolute floors and allowed direction asymmetry.
expected_evidence: Source/binary/hash, installer review and package/build manifest
GPU UUID/BDF row/column map and physical topology/peer access
Complete raw named matrix and per-pair GB/s values
Cleanup/final health, outlier disposition and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criteria says all GPU results should be 'similar' but supplies no numeric threshold, aggregation or topology-class rule; pairs with different physical paths may not be comparable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; tool, topology and oracle are normal project inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row279 Wistron-NV GPU-00272-V004: define topology-aware comparison groups for `device_to_device_bidirectional_memcpy_read_sm`, numeric per-pair GB/s floors and similarity/deviation/asymmetry thresholds, diagonal/unreachable handling, and the approved pinned nvbandwidth revision/installer.

review_improvement: Makes every GPU pair traceable and replaces subjective similarity with an approved topology-aware numeric oracle.
independent_technical_reasoning: A pairwise matrix can expose a single weak direction or path that an aggregate hides. Yet GPU pairs may traverse different NVLink hop counts or PCIe roots, so uniform equality is not a valid expectation. Mapping ordinals to topology and comparing within path classes separates real degradation from architectural differences; installer review is also needed because the provided setup script can mutate host packages.
